scripts.build: npm -w apps/electron run build && npm -w apps/ui run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm -w apps/ui run dev" "npm -w apps/electron run dev"
scripts.dev:container: concurrently -k "npm -w apps/ui run dev" "npm -w apps/electron run dev:container"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm -w apps/electron run dist
